rule: Answer key for the tuning sites. Readable by anyone and anything. Pixel positions (line, sample) are filled in by a person by eye from a 512 px crop at the published position; published coordinates are a starting point, not an answer. The scoring script reports, per piece, the rank of the true object in the candidate list and which branch found it.

pieces.note: dark impact patch about 20 x 12 m with the curved dark arc to its upper right, identical in shape to the caption's enlargement; parachute 900 m south, heat shield 1.34 km east. caption registration: the HiRISE annotated image of this strip (ESP_048041_1780-2.jpg) registered to a 3.6 km half-res region by SIFT, 152 inliers, rotation -4.3 deg
bright saturated canopy about 30 px across; sheet pick #1 of the parachute sheet (1085 m from the offset-derived anchor)
small bright object with a shadow just south of the canopy

bright debris (28 px, z 13.6) inside an 80 px dark halo, the caption's top-right inset; 1.34 km east of the scar. The earlier pick at line 26038 sample 23210 was a bright-rimmed crater and was wrong. caption registration: the HiRISE annotated image of this strip (ESP_048041_1780-2.jpg) registered to a 3.6 km half-res region by SIFT, 152 inliers, rotation -4.3 deg
grid tile 65 (parachute grid): bright white canopy about 30 px across at the tile's lower right; centre of the bright patch
grid tile 66: bright ring with a dark centre, about 12 px, 45 m NE of the canopy
heat-shield grid tile 47: bright compact object with a dark halo near the tile's top edge; about 1500 m SE of the landing point, matching PIA16001's 1500 m figure

parachute grid tile 29: dark fan-shaped blast mark about 40 m long with bright debris specks at its east end; 640 m west of the landing point (the offset-derived grid for this piece was 440 m north of it)

dark 6 px spot with a faint bright edge, 7 px from the registered caption position; the caption says the lander is dust-covered on this date with its shadows mostly absent. caption registration: the HiRISE captioned image of this strip (ESP_017716_2485_cut.jpg, main panel from PSP_009290_2485) registered to a 3 km half-res region by SIFT, 134 inliers, rotation 116.8 deg; box centres mapped to strip pixels, then refined to the nearest compact blob

bright compact object (3 px at 2 m/px, z 7.1) at the caption's box b, with the dark arc of Sleepy Hollow to its northwest as the caption says; 650 m from the object previously recorded here. caption registration: the HiRISE captioned overview of the site (PSP_001513_1655_cut_b.jpg, boxes a, b, c) registered to a 6 km region at 2 m/px by SIFT (155 inliers) and refined per box by template matching; the object then located as the brightest compact blob within 28 m at 2 m/px; precision about 2 m, to be refined at full resolution

the bright T-shaped fabric at the caption's box a (parachute and nearby backshell); this object was recorded as the lander until 2026-10-28 22:50 and was found by the sheet branch at rank 21. caption registration: the HiRISE captioned overview of the site (PSP_001513_1655_cut_b.jpg, boxes a, b, c) registered to a 6 km region at 2 m/px by SIFT (155 inliers) and refined per box by template matching; the object then located as the brightest compact blob within 28 m at 2 m/px; precision about 2 m, to be refined at full resolution
